name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Set the focus ring to 2px wide at 4.5:1 contrast with a 1px inner glow at 7:1. This balances visibility for users who need high contrast with the practical limits of screen real estate and color choices. The inner glow ensures the ring remains visible against light backgrounds while the 4.5:1 contrast meets WCAG AA standards for most users. Trade-off: the glow adds a subtle animation, which we accept to maintain clarity without relying solely on color.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring at 4.5:1 risks failing users who need *maximum* contrast—some screen readers or high-contrast modes may ignore glow effects entirely. A 3px ring at 7:1 with a 1px outer shadow (not glow) keeps crisp edges on high-DPI screens and meets WCAG AAA for focus indicators. Settle it with a live test on a 4K display at 200% zoom—if the ring stays sharp and readable, it’s the call.

name: Ramp
text:
Set the focus ring to 3px wide at 7:1 contrast with a 1px outer shadow. This meets WCAG AAA for focus indicators, ensuring visibility for users who need maximum contrast, including those in high-contrast modes or using screen readers. The trade-off is slightly more screen real estate, but this is negligible on modern displays and critical for accessibility. The outer shadow keeps edges crisp on high-DPI screens, avoiding the blur risk of inner glows.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring at 7:1 still risks blurring on high-DPI screens—inner glow fails, outer shadow softens edges. A 1px solid ring at 7:1 with 2px transparent offset (no blur) meets AAA *and* stays crisp. Test it live at 200% zoom on a 4K screen to settle.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Finalize 1px solid focus ring at 7:1 contrast with 2px transparent offset, no blur—deliver live-tested CSS in EXCAVA’s component library, owned by Ramp.
